bookings_period_bounded.name: bookings_period_bounded
bookings_period_bounded.value:
not isempty("bookings"."period") and lower_inc("bookings"."period") and not upper_inc("bookings"."period")
          and not lower_inf("bookings"."period") and not upper_inf("bookings"."period")

payments_target.name: payments_target
payments_target.value: ("payments"."booking_id" is not null) <> ("payments"."recurring_booking_id" is not null)
